purpose: Small same-backend B/C mechanism qualification before any ablation, native A/C comparison or formal matrix

selection.rule: The first six original public-trace chains in their existing order; no performance, latency, SLO outcome or post-run support filtering
selection.scope_warning: This is a support-window mechanism smoke, not evidence of full-public-trace coverage or superiority

generation_and_deadline.whole_chain_rule: Primary strict chain rule: arrival + 20 * actual chain stage_num; finish <= deadline
generation_and_deadline.scheduler_request_slo_rule: Both arms receive the official client request SLO scaled by collection_id % 4 + 1; C chain-goal deadline uses this received value times actual stage_num
generation_and_deadline.official_native_goodput_rule: Reproduce the official request goodput using the official scaled collection-SLO convention; report it separately from primary unscaled strict-chain attainment and strict-chain call goodput

arms.B: Existing full JITServe semantics in the shared study-owned backend
arms.C: stage6 v2_slo_execution_v1 with execution-aligned evaluation and conditional graph backoff predictor in the identical backend

qualification_gates: B and C complete all six main chains and preserve all 40 main calls plus the separate warmup
Both arms use the same public prompts, deadlines, generation contract and backend source
C has at least one supported multi-goal candidate with distinguishable scores
C accepts at least one non-default model action and executes its anchor or changed lease
No compound group is split and no batch exceeds four real requests
Strict whole-chain attainment, same-ID gained/lost chains, JCT, tail latency, overhead and KV accounts are recomputed independently
All study-owned processes exit and the authorized GPU is released
stop_rules: Stop without an authorized idle physical GPU; do not select a device implicitly
Stop after the small pair; no automatic ablation or matrix expansion
If C has no executed model action, do not interpret the result as a mechanism win or loss
If C is not better than B, do not start A/C to search for a favorable system result
No chain substitution, deadline tuning, added seeds, predictor retuning or HOLDOUT
Preserve every failed and partial attempt and signal only registered processes
